ee:transform.doc:name: Prepare Warning Email Payload, var : subject

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain
fun safe(v, d = "N/A") = if (v == null or (v is String and trim(v) == "")) d else v
var integration = vars.integration default vars.initialVariables default {} var cdm = (vars.initialPayload default [])[0].b2bMessage default {} var header = cdm.header default {}
var senderKey = header.senderId default ""
var vendorId = if (senderKey != "") (p("partner.inbound." ++ senderKey) default p("partner.outbound." ++ senderKey) default "N/A") else "N/A"
var poNumber = safe(header.poNumber)
var namePercentage = vars.isValid.validationErrors.shipToNameMatchPercentage default null
var addressPercentage = vars.isValid.validationErrors.shipToAddressMatchPercentage default null
var lowerLimit = (Mule::p("shipToValidation.lowerLimit") as Number)
var upperLimit = (Mule::p("shipToValidation.upperLimit") as Number)
var data = { lowerLimit: lowerLimit as String, upperLimit: upperLimit as String,
shipToNameMatchPercentage: if (namePercentage != null) ((namePercentage as Number) as String {format: "00.00"}) ++ "%" else "N/A",
shipToAddressMatchPercentage: if (addressPercentage != null) ((addressPercentage as Number) as String {format: "00.00"}) ++ "%" else "N/A",
flowDirection: if (lower(safe(integration.source, "APM")) == "apm") "INBOUND" else "OUTBOUND",
documentType: safe(integration."integration-type", safe(header.documentType, "API")),
warningTitle: "Ship-To Validation Warning",
bannerColor: "#f59e0b",
warningType: "SHIP_TO_VALIDATION_WARNING",
warningCategory: "SHIP_TO_VALIDATION",
status: "PROCESSED WITH WARNING",
companyName: vars.purchaseOrderData.value.company_no[0] default "N/A",
vendorName: vendorId,
route: safe(integration.source, "APM") ++ " → Mule → " ++ safe(integration.target, "P21"),
businessKey: "PO " ++ poNumber,
timestamp: (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 'UTC'"},
transmissionId: safe(header.transmissionId),
keyLabel: "Correlation ID",
key: correlationId default uuid(),
transactionType: safe(integration."integration-type", safe(header.documentType, "API")),
appName: p("api.name") default "Mule Application",
environment: upper(p("mule.env") default "DEV"),
message: "Purchase Order " ++ poNumber ++ " was processed successfully with a warning.",
warningDescription: "Ship-To validation results:" ++ "\n• Ship-To Name Match Percentage: " ++ ( if (namePercentage != null) ((namePercentage as Number) as String {format: "00.00"}) else "N/A" ) ++ "%" ++ "\n• Ship-To Address Match Percentage: " ++ ( if (addressPercentage != null) ((addressPercentage as Number) as String {format: "00.00"}) else "N/A" ) ++ "%" ++ "\n\nThe transaction was processed because one or more Ship-To validation match percentages fell within the configured warning threshold range of " ++ (lowerLimit as String) ++ "% and " ++ (upperLimit as String) ++ "%.",
warningResolution: "No action is required. Please review the Ship-To Name and Ship-To Address information if necessary." }
var template = readUrl( "classpath://templates/warning-template.html", "text/plain" )
--- template replace /\$\{(\w+)\}/ with ((m) -> (data[m[1]] as String) default "")

%dw 2.0
output application/json

%dw 2.0 output text/plain
fun safe(v, d = "N/A") = if (v == null or (v is String and trim(v) == "")) d else v

var senderKey = header.senderId default "" var vendorId = if (senderKey != "") (p("partner.inbound." ++ senderKey) default p("partner.outbound." ++ senderKey) default "N/A") else "N/A"
var poNumber = safe(header.poNumber)
var data = { flowDirection: if (lower(safe(integration.source, "APM")) == "apm") "INBOUND" else "OUTBOUND",

successTitle: "P21 Processing Completed",
bannerColor: "#16a34a",
status: "SUCCESS",
statusMessage: "P21 Processing Completed Successfully",
companyName: vars.purchaseOrderData.value.company_no[0] default "N/A",
vendorName: vendorId,
route: safe(integration.source, "APM") ++ " → Mule → " ++ safe(integration.target, "P21"),
businessKey: "PO " ++ poNumber,
timestamp: (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 'UTC'"},
transmissionId: safe(header.transmissionId),
keyLabel: "Correlation ID",
key: correlationId default uuid(),
transactionType: safe( integration."integration-type", safe(header.documentType, "API") ),

p21OrderNumber: poNumber,
statusCode: "200" }
